wireConventions.tenantContext: Server-resolved; never trust body schoolId as authorization

notes: Catalog enumerates feature operations and contract responsibilities; implementation must generate precise DTO/OpenAPI schemas and contract tests.
Counts include surface aliases; they are specification entries, not claims of implemented endpoints.
Route paths are new and must be collision-checked at OR00; existing assessment adapters remain unchanged.
Permission arrays express baseline ALL requirements; operation notes and state contract can add branch-specific requirements.
Query filters and request patches are allowlisted in DTO_DICTIONARY.md; unknown input properties are rejected.
Private generated-file access must also be enforced through any generic Files route.

Empty.description: No request body. Path and declared query parameters still validate.

ListQuery.description: cursor?, limit 1..200, allowlisted filters/sort; bound to current authorized scope.

VersionedPatchRequest.description: Period/group metadata allowlist only; no state/kind/year/term/subject ownership mutation. Resource revision CAS.

PeriodReopenPreviewRequest.description: Preview broad archived reopen to OPEN or ENTRY_CLOSED; enumerate affected work, policy/capabilities and publications retained.

PeriodReopenRequest.description: ENTRY_CLOSED ordinary reopen; ARCHIVED additionally requires previewId,previewDigest,targetStatus and periods.manage+archives.manage.

ReportingPeriodCreateRequest.description: School-local date YYYY-MM-DD; termId required for TERM/CUSTOM; period completeness/open rules explicit.

CorrectionWindowRequest.description: targets are exact slotId+releaseUnitId+authorizedActorIds tuples; time-bounded archive correction; normal action permissions remain required.

GroupCreateRequest.description: SUBJECT requires subjectId; CUSTOM requires school-owned stable code.

TemplateCloneRequest.description: Clone into school ownership; platform template never edited.

TemplateActivateRequest.description: Activate reviewed immutable version; no automatic migration.

TemplateActivationPreviewRequest.description: Preview template activation for future resolution; existing-sheet adoption remains explicit.

ScopeResolveRequest.description: Resolve concrete eligible tuples and conflicts at explicit roster-as-of instant.

CapabilitiesQuery.description: Optional sheetId,slotId,reportingPeriodId,groupId; no caller actor/school override.

RosterPreviewRequest.description: Optional selectedSlotIds; preview authoritative enrollment/eligibility changes without mutation.

SheetMaterializeRequest.description: Idempotently reuse/create canonical sheets from exact resolution.

DesignCreateRequest.description: Versioned personal/school draft design; no independent official duplicate.

DesignDecisionRequest.description: Approve or return immutable design; return requires comment.

DraftDefinitionPreviewRequest.description: Preview adopting a validated personal/school draft schema, retained values, superseded candidates and conflicts.

DraftDefinitionAdoptRequest.description: Adopt exact reviewed draft schema and explicit field mapping; does not grant school official-design acceptance.

GrantCreateRequest.description: Explicit grantee USER/ROLE and ID; exact group/period/classroom scope, allowlisted operations and required reason; optional expiry.

RosterReconcileRequest.description: Explicit transfer/eligibility reconciliation; reasons for changes.

GridPatchRequest.description: Atomic sheet batch of typed CellOperation with cell CAS; expectedSheetRevision is structural; limit1000.

ReviewDecisionRequest.description: Required candidateKind RESULT_RELEASE|AGGREGATE dispatches to the matching tenant-owned candidate type. Exact candidate ID/revision/contentDigest; APPROVE or RETURN with required comment for return. Aggregate approval binds immutable profileVersionId, exact sourcePublicationIds and dependency generations; current authority/policy/separation apply. Changed or ineligible dependencies invalidate pending approval; publish rechecks.

CorrectionRequest.description: Open/reuse correction draft; optional validated operations.

PublicationRevokeRequest.description: Revoke exact active release, no fallback to older publication.

PublicationTopologyPreviewRequest.description: Exact school-owned per-slot replacement bundle; no output overlap or unresolved dependency.

PublicationTopologyReplaceRequest.description: Atomic activation of exact reviewed replacement set; keeps unaffected explicit refs.

AggregateProfileRequest.description: POST creates a root/first immutable version when expectedProfileRevision=0 and profileId is forbidden. When expectedProfileRevision>0, profileId is required (UUID), must identify a current-school profile, and is compare-and-swapped under current management authority before a new immutable version is created. Definition has published-dependency rules, explicit audience and coverage. Existing published aggregates are never silently changed.

AggregateCandidateRequest.description: Freeze eligible immutable source publication references.

AggregatePublishRequest.description: Exact immutable aggregate candidate/digest/revision; null expected current only for first release. Recheck pinned applicable profile version, exact source publication pointers/dependency generations, matching AGGREGATE review decision when required, current policy and publication authority. Stale or changed inputs cannot reuse approval.

ExportCreateRequest.description: Materialize reviewed export manifest and private file.

ImportUploadRequest.description: Optional validateOptions.clearReason; CSV/XLSX actual parsing. Replacing same-batch source additionally requires expectedBatchRevision.

ImportCorrectionRequest.description: rowRef+fieldId, typed SET/CLEAR, optional reason; new validation version.

ImportCancelRequest.description: Cancel only not-yet-claimed units; running atomic unit finishes all-or-none. Mixed committed/cancelled units report PARTIALLY_APPLIED with terminationReason CANCELLED; no eligible cancellable units or terminal APPLIED returns409.

ImportRetryRequest.description: Retry eligible uncommitted transient-failure units only; current authorization and preview validity rechecked.

ImportConfirmRequest.description: Exact sorted selected sheets; frozen effective clear reason if present.

PreviewRequest.description: STUDENT or PARENT; authorized staff projection of path-selected candidate.
